root_cause: PR-2B/2C hardened the listing/approval surface only. The research, ingestion, learning, upload and agent surfaces were never included in the same pass, so requireAuth/requireRole was applied per-route by hand instead of via a centralized registry. No mechanism exists to detect an unclassified route, so the bug class regenerates on every new endpoint. Separately, several services were written with 'always return something so the UI never looks empty' as the design goal, which converts absent evidence into fabricated business signal.
source_of_truth_review: No new source of truth proposed. Recommended route registry consolidates classification that is currently implicit and scattered across 43 call sites; it derives from the existing requireAuth/requireRole middleware rather than replacing it. No change to publishGate.js or approval authority.
